services.name: Manta Ray Snorkel
services.desc: Yes! Everyone who enters the water needs to be able to comfortably swim a minimum of 25 yards in the ocean without a life jacket. Please wear your swim suit to the harbor, and bring a towel and reef safe sunscreen. We will provide all the gear that’s required for the tour (snorkel, mask, fins, floatation). We require a minimum of 6 guests to run all tours. If we do not reach our minimum, we will offer to rebook you to a different tour or issue a full refund. Alternatively, you can purchase additional tickets to reach the minimum of 6 guests, which will ensure the trip can run. Cancel up to 24 hours before your tour time for a full refund.
